messages:
Ari: FYI customers seeing 429/503 when requests are routed to slower pools. They want clearer programmatic hints to decide retry vs backoff.

Ari: Simple proposal: keep HTTP codes but add `client_action` (enum) and `route_origin` (stable string). Example: `{"status":429, "error":"CapacityFallback", "client_action":"reduce_batch_size", "route_origin":"degraded_pool", "request_id":"r-123"}`

Jasper: +1. Call it `client_action`. Values: `no_action`, `retry`, `reduce_batch_size`, `fallback_model`, `split_requests`. Keep snake_case.

Leila: Telemetry: emit `route.origin` and `client_action` as span tags and log fields. Stable tag set: degraded_pool, fallback_pool, primary, regional_failover. Add an infra alert when >5% tenant traffic has route.origin=degraded_pool for 5m.

Mike: SDKs: we'll add typed enum in next minor. Older SDKs must ignore unknown fields. For streaming, include a one-off control frame and `X-Redwood-Client-Action` header.

Ari: Console UX: tiny badge on route card "degraded routing" with `console_copy` short text (under 80 chars). Localize later. Rollout behind flag.

Jasper: Do not surface internal cost numbers. Keep payload consumer-friendly.

Leila: Migration plan: feature flag `expose_client_action` rollout_pct. Telemetry dims must be in staging before enabling. Also add unit tests to verify unknown fields don't break old clients.

Mike: Rollout snippet: `expose_client_action: enabled=true, rollout_pct=20, targets=[hosted,dedicated]`. I'll add SDK tests and changelog.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout created: feature=expose_client_action pct=20 -> 2026-04-01T02:00Z

Ari: Next: runtime PR to add route tag + enrich envelope, Leila adds dashboard/alert, Mike updates SDKs, Jasper writes routing->action matrix. Target 2-week window.

Leila: I'll verify cardinality in staging and add dashboard tile.

Ari: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
